queer_characters.name: Timothy
queer_characters.notes: Described as an openly gay high school senior who is the film's protagonist; his perspective drives the magical-realist plot exploring homophobia through role reversal.

contributor_notes: Source text confirms Timothy as an openly gay protagonist.
